_comment: Landing page content, mirroring the Steam Workshop description. Both languages sit in the same field so translation drift is visible. Proper nouns come from ../nippon_expedition/_docs/translation/术语对照_*.tsv — do not invent new ones.

eyebrow.en: Total War: WARHAMMER III · Faction mod

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · 玉海舰队

premise.zh: 沈长风率领舰队远征尼朋，她需要在新的土地上寻找立足之地。
premise.en: Shen Changfeng leads her fleet east to Nippon, where she must carve out a foothold on new soil.

note.en: The English text is AI-translated. Corrections welcome in the comments.

crest_alt.en: Crest of the Jade Sea Fleet

art_alt.zh: 玉海舰队在尼朋近海抛锚，沈长风立于岸上远眺
art_alt.en: The Jade Sea Fleet at anchor off Nippon, Shen Changfeng watching from the shore

items.zh: 一个新的震旦可玩派系
items.en: A new playable Grand Cathay faction

items.zh: 1 名新传奇领主，3 名新传奇英雄，1 种通用领主，1 种通用英雄，10 个新兵种，1 种新法系
items.en: 1 Legendary Lord, 3 Legendary Heroes, 1 generic lord, 1 generic hero, 10 new units, 1 new spell lore

items.zh: 自动搬家一些原版传奇领主到尼朋以及尼朋周边区域（可在 MCT 中关闭）
items.en: Relocates vanilla legendary lords to Nippon and the lands around it (can be switched off in MCT)

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · NRS 兼容包
name.en: Nippon Expedition · Nippon Rising Sun Compatibility Patch

note.zh: [Nippon, Land of the Rising Sun](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3770643554)（NRS）兼容子 mod。可选，两者同时使用时需要。
note.en: [Nippon, Land of the Rising Sun](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3770643554) (NRS) compatibility submod. Optional, needed only when running both mods together.

points.zh: 修复了启动 NRS 时定居点模型不显示，其他派系无法占领定居点等问题
points.en: Fixes settlement models not rendering, and other factions being unable to occupy settlements, while NRS is running

points.zh: 增加了一系列尼朋兵种招募建筑，震旦的派系可以通过任务解锁尼朋系列建筑（玉海舰队默认解锁）
points.en: Adds a series of Nippon unit-recruitment buildings, which Cathay factions can unlock through missions (unlocked by default for the Jade Sea Fleet)

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · 震旦机制兼容包
name.en: Nippon Expedition · Cathay Mechanics Compatibility Patch

note.zh: 震旦机制兼容子 mod。已支持：
note.en: Cathay mechanics compatibility submod. Currently supports:

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · 溟龙胤隐兵种兼容包
name.en: Nippon Expedition · Yin-Yin Unit Compatibility Patch

note.zh: [溟龙胤隐](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2989226363)兵种兼容子 mod。可选，两者同时使用时需要。
note.en: [Roar of the Jade Sea: Yin-Yin, the Sea Dragon](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2989226363) unit compatibility submod. Optional, needed only when running both mods together.

points.zh: 震旦的派系可以招募胤隐 mod 的兵种
points.en: Cathay factions can recruit the units added by the Yin-Yin mod

points.zh: 玉海舰队的旗舰新增「海贼舱」建筑链
points.en: A new Corsair Berth chain on the Jade Sea Fleet's flagship

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · 兵戈天下兵种兼容包
name.en: Nippon Expedition · War under Heaven Unit Compatibility Patch

note.zh: [兵戈天下](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3297754796)兵种兼容子 mod。可选，两者同时使用时需要。
note.en: [War under Heaven](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3297754796) unit compatibility submod. Optional, needed only when running both mods together.

points.zh: 玉海舰队可以在旗舰上招募卫东列省的特色兵种，开局即可招
points.en: The Jade Sea Fleet can recruit the Eastern Provinces' special units aboard the flagship, from the start of the campaign

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · 周边 AI 强化

note.zh: AI 强化子 mod，可选。对整体 AI 进行了强化，并且对尼朋以及震旦周边的 AI 进行一些特殊强化。
note.en: Stronger AI submod, optional. It strengthens the AI across the whole map, with extra tuning for Nippon and the lands around Cathay.

items.zh: **需要 MIXER 和 IEE 扩展**：[Immortal Empires Expanded](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007996493) 与 [Mixu's Unlocker](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859968660)；可选 [Mod Configuration Tool](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021)
items.en: **Requires MIXER and IEE**: [Immortal Empires Expanded](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007996493) and [Mixu's Unlocker](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859968660); optional [Mod Configuration Tool](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021)

lords._comment: 一行可以放一到多个条目，`side` 决定兵牌图落在文字的哪一侧。两个通用角色合成一行，所以第三行有两个条目。

body.zh: 具有特色游牧系统，可使用深渊系，阳系法术。可使用『云帆号跃迁』系统
body.en: A nomadic faction with its own mechanics. Casts from the Lore of the Deep and the Lore of Yang. Can use the Cloud Sails leap.

body.zh: 可通过远征同伴系统招募。
body.en: Recruited through the Expedition Companions system.

body.zh: 尼朋武将，可为尼朋兵种提供独特加成。可骑乘麒麟。
body.en: A Nipponese commander granting unique bonuses to Nipponese units. Mountable on a Kirin.

body.zh: 侍奉尼朋诸神的神职之女。可使用全新的巫女系法术。
body.en: A shrine maiden serving Nippon's gods, with an entirely new Miko spell lore.

lede.zh: 远征途中会遇到身份各异的同伴，在专属的「远征同伴」面板上召集她们、推进各自的章节任务、提升羁绊等级。
lede.en: Companions of very different backgrounds join the expedition along the way. Muster them from a dedicated Expedition Companions panel, advance their chapter quests, raise their bond.

chapters.en: The Bell in the Ruined Shrine
The Sanctum of the Divine Beast

notes.zh: 每档解锁对应的部队与同伴加成
notes.en: Each tier unlocks that companion's units and bonuses

notes.zh: **名望**：在面板中用名望购买已解锁的部队
notes.en: **Renown**: spend it in the panel to buy the units you have unlocked

notes.zh: **章节任务链**：三条独立任务链。完成任务以推进羁绊等级
notes.en: **Chapter quest lines**: three separate chains. Complete them to raise the bond tier

body.zh: 玉海舰队的旗舰本身就是一条建筑树。
body.en: The Jade Sea Fleet's flagship is itself a building tree.

body.zh: 引雷之峰、輝山锻冶场、枪术道场、神兽宫、灵道社殿，各自解锁独有的加成或兵种。
body.en: Thunder-Drawing Peak, Hikariya Forge, Yari Dojo, Divine Beast Sanctum and the Vim-To Shrine, each with its own bonuses or units.

body.zh: 稻荷神社 → 稻荷大社 → 灵兽神宫。依次解锁稻荷灵狐使者、巫女、麒麟。
body.en: Inari Shrine → Inari Grand Shrine → Divine Beast Sanctuary. Unlocks the Inari Fox Emissary, the Miko and the Kirin in turn.

body.zh: 番所 → 侍所 → 旗本番。依次解锁长枪武士、铁炮武士、雷刃旗本。
body.en: Watch Post → Samurai Hall → Hatamoto Guard. Unlocks Yari Samurai, Teppo Samurai, then Thunderblade Hatamoto.

quote.zh: 踏上尼朋土地时，沈长风才发现昔日的尼朋海盗不过是乱局露出海面的一角：尼朋名义上仍奉圣日朝廷，实则诸藩大名兵戈不止，乡野凋敝，民不聊生。混沌的信徒已在尼朋扎下毒根，异族军阀与嗜血之徒也趁乱据土称雄。若她想在极东之海立下根基，便必须先让这座战火中的列岛重新认得秩序二字。
quote.en: The pirates Shen Changfeng had chased were only the part of the wreck showing above water. Nippon bows to the Holy Sun Court in name alone: the daimyo never lay down their arms, Chaos has put down poisoned roots, and foreign warlords hold land of their own. To root herself in the eastern sea, she must first teach this burning archipelago the word order again.

goals.zh: 消灭清宝天尊信徒、奥本氏、格里姆格·铁皮与『流放者』斯卡布兰德
goals.en: Destroy the Cult of Tsien-Tsin, the Okumoto Clan, Grimgor Ironhide and Skarbrand the Exiled

goals.zh: 通过直接占领、仆从协议或军事同盟，控制武士国度、日升之地与关东环陆全境
goals.en: Control Samurai's Domain, Sun's Origin and the Eastern Circuit by occupation, vassalage or military alliance

kind.zh: 长期胜利 · 路线 A

quote.zh: 极东诸海久无共主。混沌异族军阀与海上掠夺者各据港湾，商路断裂，民不聊生。若想建立一个真正强大的海外帝国，便不能满足于一处锚地或几座城邦。沈长风必须让更辽阔的海疆都听从玉海舰队的号令。
quote.en: The eastern seas have long had no master: warlords and raiders hold the harbours, and the trade routes are cut. An empire that truly stands cannot be built on one anchorage. The wider seas must answer to the Jade Sea Fleet.

goals.zh: 消灭盘踞尼朋北境的艾辛氏族深巢，以及五名趁乱据土的域外强者
goals.en: Destroy the Eshin Clan Nest in northern Nippon, plus five foreign powers that seized land in the chaos

goals.zh: 控制北星道、北陸道、屿北、艾利提斯失落群岛、百渡、南皋鲜、蛮荒迷域与无际环沼全境
goals.en: Control the Hokusei Arc, Hokurikudo, North Isle, the Lost Isles of Elithis, the Hundred Counties, Nam Khosun, the Primal Labyrinth and the Great Enveloping Swamp

kind.zh: 长期胜利 · 路线 B

quote.zh: 自受命为提督以来，沈长风便以澄清玉海、靖平海疆为己任。如今海盗从东方侵袭，鼠人暗巢蛀蚀南境，混沌与异族势力亦在天朝边陲蠢动。虽朝廷诏令仍在，旧日罪名未销，但边疆之患不会自行平息。她若要重归天朝视野，便必须以战功让巍京承认，玉海舰队仍是震旦天朝不可或缺的屏障。
quote.en: Pirates strike from the east, ratmen gnaw at the southern border, and Chaos stirs along the frontier. The old charges against Shen Changfeng are not lifted, but the danger will not settle itself. She must make Wei-jin admit by force of arms that the Jade Sea Fleet is still a bulwark Grand Cathay cannot do without.

goals.zh: 消灭丛林精魂、折磨者、艾辛氏族、艾辛氏族深巢与神佑恶党
goals.en: Destroy the Spirit of the Jungle, The Tormentors, Clan Eshin, the Eshin Clan Nest and The Blessed Dread

goals.zh: 控制北星道、申原、玉江三角洲、黎山、大运河、巨蛇河口与奸之林全境
goals.en: Control the Hokusei Arc, the Plains of Xen, the Jade River Delta, Mount Li, The Great Canal, the Serpent Estuary and the Jungles of Chi'an

lede.zh: 对尼朋和尼朋周边势力进行了重组，自动搬家大量传奇领主，可在 MCT 中关闭。
lede.en: Nippon and the powers around it have been reshuffled, relocating a number of legendary lords. Switchable off in MCT.

dest.zh: 月落之塔（艾利提斯失落群岛）
dest.en: Tower of the Setting Moon (Lost Isles of Elithis)

lede.zh: 由于尼朋岛自身资源较少，对 AI 进行了一些增强。
lede.en: Nippon is a poor island chain, so the AI there has been given a hand up.

items.zh: **搬家领主与岛上氏族的 AI 强度大幅提升**：被搬到岛上的格里姆格·铁皮、『流放者』斯卡布兰德，以及岛上的原住民氏族奥本氏、山陽氏，其军队维护费、建造与招募费用、补员速率与经验加成被抬到原版头部 AI 传奇势力的水平，中期登陆尼朋时依然盘踞一方
items.en: **Relocated lords and island clans get a large AI boost**: Grimgor Ironhide and Skarbrand the Exiled, relocated to the isles, plus the native Okumoto and Sanyo Clans, have their upkeep, construction and recruitment costs, replenishment and experience raised to the level of vanilla's strongest AI legendary factions, so they still hold ground when you land mid-campaign

items.zh: 奥本氏与山陽氏的 AI 会优先建造侍所与稻荷神社系列建筑。首府开局即为 4 级主城并自带旗本番。
items.en: The Okumoto and Sanyo Clan AI prioritise the Samurai Hall and Inari Shrine chains. Their capitals start at level 4 with a Hatamoto Guard built.

items.zh: 奥本氏与山陽氏的首领改为武士大将，附带不朽
items.en: The Okumoto and Sanyo Clan leaders are replaced with immortal Samurai Taisho

more.zh: 进一步强化：可以订阅子 mod

label.zh: 远征尼朋 · 周边 AI 强化

more_tail.zh: 。对整体 AI 进行了强化，并且对尼朋以及震旦周边的 AI 进行一些特殊强化。
more_tail.en: . It strengthens the AI across the whole map, with extra tuning for Nippon and the lands around Cathay.

items.zh: **与其他占用同一 MIXER 借位槽的 mod 冲突**：本 mod 当前借用 MIXER 预留槽位 `mixer_nip_nipponese_expedition` 作为运行宿主
items.en: **Conflicts with other mods using the same MIXER reserved slot**: this mod currently runs on `mixer_nip_nipponese_expedition`

items.zh: **与 [Nippon, Land of the Rising Sun](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3770643554) 可以同时游玩**：装上可选的 [NRS 兼容包](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3792001152)，玉海舰队会改用另一个阵营位，两个 mod 不再互相顶掉传奇领主。只订阅本体的玩家不需要装。⚠️ 装上之后，此前的玉海舰队存档读不出来。
items.en: **Playable alongside [Nippon, Land of the Rising Sun](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3770643554)**: install the optional [NRS compatibility patch](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3792001152) and the Jade Sea Fleet moves to a different faction slot, so the two mods stop overwriting each other's legendary lord. You do not need it otherwise. ⚠️ Jade Sea Fleet saves made before installing it will no longer load.

items.zh: **与其他改动尼朋地权 / 派系的 mod 可能冲突**（例如同样把领主搬到尼朋的 mod）
items.en: **May conflict with mods that change Nippon's region ownership or factions** (e.g. other mods that relocate lords there)

items.zh: 发现问题请附上：载入的 mod 列表、载入顺序、以及 Warhammer3.exe 同目录下的 `script_log_*.txt`
items.en: Bug reports: please include your mod list, load order, and `script_log_*.txt` from next to Warhammer3.exe
